hand-wraps-arboreal.name: ★ Hand Wraps | Arboreal
hand-wraps-arboreal.desc: Preferred by hand-to-hand fighters, these wraps protect the knuckles and stabilize the wrist when punching. These bias-tape handwraps have been dyed with a forest camo pattern.

ak-47-the-empress.name: AK-47 | The Empress
ak-47-the-empress.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted using the Empress tarot card as inspiration.

Wealth comes in many forms

aug-amber-slipstream.name: AUG | Amber Slipstream
aug-amber-slipstream.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been hand painted with a smoky grey and vibrant orange hydrographic.

Please keep your hands and arms inside the vehicle

awp-redline.name: AWP | Redline
awp-redline.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been painted using a carbon fiber hydrographic and a dry-transfer decal of a red pinstripe.

Never be afraid to push it to the limit

bayonet-black-laminate.name: ★ Bayonet | Black Laminate
bayonet-black-laminate.desc: Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been stonewashed and given a black laminate handle.

bayonet-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Bayonet | Forest DDPAT
bayonet-forest-ddpat.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

pp-bizon-rust-coat.name: PP-Bizon | Rust Coat
pp-bizon-rust-coat.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. This memento from Siege is still perfectly operational although the exterior surfaces have rusted.

Scars build character

cz75-auto-poison-dart.name: CZ75-Auto | Poison Dart
cz75-auto-poison-dart.desc: A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been painted using a hydrographic inspired by a poison dart frog.

desert-eagle-ocean-drive.name: Desert Eagle | Ocean Drive
desert-eagle-ocean-drive.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been custom painted using oversaturated colors and different shapes.

Can't miss—both the colors and when using the weapon

dual-berettas-cobra-strike.name: Dual Berettas | Cobra Strike
dual-berettas-cobra-strike.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. A cobra has been hand painted on either grip. The slide displays its neon venom.

They always strike back

dual-berettas-pyre.name: Dual Berettas | Pyre
dual-berettas-pyre.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been painted using a rust-tinted hydrographic of a gel pen doodle.

Honor your dead

famas-pulse.name: FAMAS | Pulse
famas-pulse.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been painted with a hydrographic of bold fuchsia fragments.

Striking colors for a striking weapon

famas-bad-trip.name: FAMAS | Bad Trip
famas-bad-trip.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been custom painted with brightly colored monsters.

When you've had too much

g3sg1-green-apple.name: G3SG1 | Green Apple
g3sg1-green-apple.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a green and black color scheme.

An apple a day keeps insurance premiums high

galil-ar-shattered.name: Galil AR | Shattered
galil-ar-shattered.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. This memento from Agency has been painted with a polygonal patterned hydrographic.

My men are professionals, they'll get the job done right... - Elliott Kingsman, Career Criminal

galil-ar-akoben.name: Galil AR | Akoben
galil-ar-akoben.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. A rust-colored pattern has been spray painted over a white base.

Your personal battle cry

glock-18-sand-dune.name: Glock-18 | Sand Dune
glock-18-sand-dune.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. This memento from Gwalior has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a sand dune color scheme.

Gonzo journalist Alex Kincaide disappeared after traveling to The Maghreb to cover Operation Vanguard

glock-18-coral-bloom.name: Glock-18 | Coral Bloom
glock-18-coral-bloom.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. A vintage pattern of roses over a coral pink base has been applied.

LOL (lots of love), Grandma

p2000-panther-camo.name: P2000 | Panther Camo
p2000-panther-camo.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. A black panther spotted finish has been applied.

Find your shady spot

p2000-imperial-dragon.name: P2000 | Imperial Dragon
p2000-imperial-dragon.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has custom painted with the motif of a dragon using red metallic paints.

Look to the West

p2000-grip-tape.name: P2000 | Grip Tape
p2000-grip-tape.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. A pattern using different sheens of silver paint has been applied. Parts of the grip have been painted using a dark, matte paint to resemble grip tape.

Hold tight!

p2000-marsh.name: P2000 | Marsh
p2000-marsh.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been painted using different shades of green metallic flake paint.

A pleasant surprise

survival-knife-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Survival Knife | Doppler
survival-knife-doppler-phase-2.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

survival-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Survival Knife | Slaughter
survival-knife-slaughter.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

paracord-knife-damascus-steel.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Damascus Steel
paracord-knife-damascus-steel.desc: This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has some damascus steel parts.

falchion-knife-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Doppler
falchion-knife-doppler-sapphire.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

flip-knife-bright-water.name: ★ Flip Knife | Bright Water
flip-knife-bright-water.desc: Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been painted using a blue camo hydrographic.

navaja-knife-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Doppler
navaja-knife-doppler-phase-3.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

navaja-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Safari Mesh
navaja-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

m9-bayonet-blue-steel.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Blue Steel
m9-bayonet-blue-steel.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

nomad-knife-doppler-phase-3.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Doppler
nomad-knife-doppler-phase-3.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

nomad-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Safari Mesh
nomad-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

shadow-daggers-black-laminate.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Black Laminate
shadow-daggers-black-laminate.desc: Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been stonewashed and given a black laminate handle.

shadow-daggers-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Forest DDPAT
shadow-daggers-forest-ddpat.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

skeleton-knife-blue-steel.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Blue Steel
skeleton-knife-blue-steel.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been cold blued.

This is the malbec of weapon design - Booth, Arms Dealer

stiletto-knife-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Doppler
stiletto-knife-doppler-sapphire.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

bowie-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-4.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Gamma Doppler
bowie-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-4.desc: This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

bowie-knife-freehand.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Freehand
bowie-knife-freehand.desc: This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted black and purple, then decorated with a metallic marker.

huntsman-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler
huntsman-knife-gamma-doppler-phase-2.desc: A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

huntsman-knife-scorched.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Scorched
huntsman-knife-scorched.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

talon-knife-ultraviolet.name: ★ Talon Knife | Ultraviolet
talon-knife-ultraviolet.desc:
This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

m249-system-lock.name: M249 | System Lock
m249-system-lock.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been custom painted with a sci-fi design.

Coverfire never looked so good

m249-sage-camo.name: M249 | Sage Camo
m249-sage-camo.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. A green and grey hydrographic pattern has been applied.

"We weren't sure if we were the ambushers... or the ambushees"

m4a4-turbine.name: M4A4 | Turbine
m4a4-turbine.desc:
More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been custom painted with a wine-colored base.

WARNING: Prolonged firing may cause overheating

m4a1-s-stratosphere.name: M4A1-S | Stratosphere
m4a1-s-stratosphere.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been custom painted with spacefaring ships circling a planet in outer space.

"One day in the not too distant future..."

mac-10-copper-borre.name: MAC-10 | Copper Borre
mac-10-copper-borre.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. A Norse inspired pattern of gold interlocking rings has been applied.

We end the way we began; in the dirt

mac-10-case-hardened.name: MAC-10 | Case Hardened
mac-10-case-hardened.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

mac-10-calf-skin.name: MAC-10 | Calf Skin
mac-10-calf-skin.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been hand painted with a brown checkerboard pattern and white accents.

Included with the $1,050 Premium Package

mag-7-hazard.name: MAG-7 | Hazard
mag-7-hazard.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. This memento from Siege has been spray-painted in a hazard stripe pattern.

DO NOT CROSS

mp9-spy-prototype.name: MP9 | Spy Prototype
mp9-spy-prototype.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been custom painted using a white satin base and finished with blue designs.

Results may vary

nova-antique.name: Nova | Antique
nova-antique.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been painted using a combination of hydrographics and dry-transfer decals to create the look of a wood stock and gold inlay.

With age comes wisdom and stopping power

nova-bloomstick.name: Nova | Bloomstick
nova-bloomstick.desc: The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been airbrushed by hand with a cherry blossom motif, then given a high-gloss topcoat.

p250-mint-kimono.name: P250 | Mint Kimono
p250-mint-kimono.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been spray-painted with a geometric motif.

Come Booth, let me show you what I've been working on - Yukako, Gunsmith

p90-nostalgia.name: P90 | Nostalgia
p90-nostalgia.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been custom painted with a CT from the main menu of the original Counter-Strike.

Minutes to install but a lifetime to master

p90-vent-rush.name: P90 | Vent Rush
p90-vent-rush.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been custom painted to resemble a P90 intersecting with gaffer tape, tubes, and fire.

"Do you know how fast you were going?"

p90-ash-wood.name: P90 | Ash Wood
p90-ash-wood.desc: Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been spray-painted freehand using twigs as stencils.

scar-20-contractor.name: SCAR-20 | Contractor
scar-20-contractor.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has individual parts spray-painted tan, navy and dark green.

Rona Sabri still hasn't forgiven Sebastien for not selecting her to go after Turner

sg-553-waves-perforated.name: SG 553 | Waves Perforated
sg-553-waves-perforated.desc: The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. It has been spray-painted using ripped tape strips and perforated metal as stencils.

ssg-08-ghost-crusader.name: SSG 08 | Ghost Crusader
ssg-08-ghost-crusader.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been painted white and given arctic blue accents.

I can never replace what was taken from us... but I can take even more from them - The Phoenix and The Initiate Part 2

tec-9-flash-out.name: Tec-9 | Flash Out
tec-9-flash-out.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been custom painted to resemble a flashbang grenade.

Re: Dance lessons with Jordan

tec-9-jambiya.name: Tec-9 | Jambiya
tec-9-jambiya.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been hand painted and laser-etched with middle eastern patterns.

Shahrazad told 1000 tales... this is the last one you'll hear

ump-45-primal-saber.name: UMP-45 | Primal Saber
ump-45-primal-saber.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been given a decal of a sabertooth tiger skull

Every predator eventually meets their end

ump-45-bone-pile.name: UMP-45 | Bone Pile
ump-45-bone-pile.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. This memento from Cache has been painted with skulls over a wiring diagram.

One more for the collection

ump-45-neo-noir.name: UMP-45 | Neo-Noir
ump-45-neo-noir.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. It has been custom painted with a stylized blue-magenta woman over a grayscale background.

"Blade in hand, she decided it was time to take a stand"

usp-s-neo-noir.name: USP-S | Neo-Noir
usp-s-neo-noir.desc:
A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted with a stylized blue-magenta woman over a grayscale background.

"Drenched in a neon glow, she lies at the foot of an oppressive skyscraper"
